title: Game
description: keel: the tick against its 33 ms budget, the boats and connections, what each player costs, AI apps’ sign-in, the machine sailors and their agents, and how far behind persistence is.

panels.title: The tick
panels.description: How long a tick takes. 33 ms is the whole budget; the alert fires at 25 ms.

panels.title: Ticks late and skipped
panels.description: 30 a second when all is well; none late, none skipped.

panels.title: Closes, by code
panels.description: 1000 and 1001 are players leaving; 1012 a restart; 4xxx the game's own.

panels.title: Snapshot lag
panels.description: Ticks between the world's newest frame and the one a connection was last sent.

panels.title: Phones: round trip and frame time
Accounts
panels.description: Accounts made, each with its first passkey; sign-ins with a passkey, by the browser’s prompt or offered on the name field; names refused; passkeys the server refused; recovery codes used; accounts deleted.

panels.title: Phones: tier and render scale
panels.description: Clients connected by the tier they draw at (low, medium, high, or unknown: a client that does not say), and the median and 10th percentile of the pixel ratio they draw at. Adaptive quality moves a phone down the tiers when its frames run slow.

panels.title: Machine sailors
panels.description: Machine sailors made, in the game or on the approval page, and deleted, by their owners or with their owners’ accounts.

panels.title: Authorizations
panels.description: AI apps’ authorization requests: the approval page shown, the request refused, approved with the owner’s passkey, or denied.

panels.title: Tokens
panels.description: Token requests from AI apps, by grant type and result.

panels.title: Refresh tokens presented again
panels.description: Refresh tokens presented a second time: within the grace, or after it, which revokes the grant.

panels.title: Registrations
panels.description: AI apps’ dynamic registrations: registered, refused, or limited.

panels.title: Metadata documents
panels.description: AI apps’ client metadata documents: fetched, from the cache, refused (too many lately) or failed.

panels.title: Fetching one
panels.description: How long fetching an AI app’s metadata document took.

panels.title: The MCP address’s door
panels.description: Requests at the MCP address: accepted, or refused, by why.

panels.title: The door’s check, 99th percentile
panels.description: How long the door took to check a token, by whether the grant was cached (warm) or looked up (cold).

panels.title: Live grants
panels.description: Grants unrevoked and within the lifetime: approved AI apps, and connection tokens.

panels.title: Accounts stopped
panels.description: Grants unrevoked and within the lifetime: approved AI apps, and connection tokens.

panels.title: The owner’s account actions, and refusals of stopped accounts
panels.description: Grants unrevoked and within the lifetime: approved AI apps, and connection tokens.

panels.title: Tool calls, by tool and result
panels.description: Tool calls at the MCP address, by tool, and by result: ok, refused (in the call’s result) or error.

panels.title: Tool calls, by app
panels.description: Tool calls at the MCP address, by the app that called and its protocol era.

panels.title: Call time, by tool
panels.description: How long a tool call took, a wait included: observe’s median is its wait.

panels.title: Waits, by what ended them
panels.description: Waits of observe, by what ended them: a wake’s kind, the time asked, a later call (superseded), the call’s stream closed (cut) or keel stopping.

panels.title: Waits cut short, by app
panels.description: How long a wait had run when its call’s stream closed before it ended, by app: where each host cuts long calls.

panels.title: Waits asked and served, median
panels.description: Waits of observe: the seconds asked for, and the seconds served before the answer.

panels.title: Refusals, by kind
panels.description: Tool calls refused in their result, by the refusal’s kind.

panels.title: The lookout report’s size
panels.description: The lookout report’s size in tokens, estimated from its length, by detail: brief or full.

panels.title: Helms
panels.description: Machine sailors whose agents have called since keel started, held in memory.

panels.title: Boats by kind, with the cap and the reserve
panels.description: Boats at sea, by kind; the most machine sailors sail at once (the cap), and how many places are kept for them ahead of humans waiting (the reserve).

panels.title: Queues by kind
panels.description: Places waiting for a boat, in the humans’ queue and the machine sailors’.

panels.title: The queues’ heads, waited
panels.description: How long the head of each kind’s queue has waited.

panels.title: Capsizes an hour, by who
panels.description: Capsizes, by who sailed the boat: a human or a machine sailor.

panels.title: Silences an hour
panels.description: Machine sailors’ boats sent into their grace after their agents fell silent.

panels.title: Oldest unwritten change
panels.description: The alert fires past 10 s.

panels.title: Batches written
panels.description: fenced: this keel lost the simulation's lease.

panels.title: The lease
panels.description: The epoch rises by one each time a keel takes the simulation.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Cores.
